notes_filipino:
*Sam- -an* + *pinaka-* + *nakaka-* + ginaw

This is because an absolute zero temperature is the coldest of the coldest and a Big Freeze is where the universe expands so much it reaches absolute zero coldness (the *nakaka-* part in the word).

If you think about it, it looks similar to pinakanakakapagpabagabag lol.
notes_bisaya: *Sang-* + *hing-* + *kina- -an-* + bugnaw\n\nThis is because an absolute zero temperature is the coldest of the coldest and a Big Freeze is where the universe expands so much it reaches absolute zero coldness (the *hing-* part in the word since it is its propensity or habit).

notes_filipino: *Sam- -an* + *pina-* + unat\n\nThis is because a Big Rip means something is pulling or stretching out the atoms apart by dark matter (*pina-*) to infinitely increase their distance (stretched apart).
notes_bisaya: *Sang- -an* + *gipa--* + ungat\n\nThis is because a Big Rip means something is pulling or stretching out the atoms apart by dark matter, with object focus on the matter being stretched apart (*gipa-*) to infinitely increase their distance (stretched apart).

notes_filipino: *Sam- -an* + *pinag-* + siksik\n\nThis is because a Big Crunch means after a certain amount of matter, the universe eventually compresses upon itself as if willingly (*pinag-*).
notes_bisaya: *Sam- -an* + *gina-* + piit\n\nThis is because a Big Crunch means after a certain amount of matter, the universe eventually compresses upon itself, with emphasis on passive voice-ish (*gina-*).
